bluf: Search Laboratory is a Leeds data science led search and performance agency, founded 2005, in the Havas network since 2021 and merged with Havas Market UK in January 2025 into a c.150 person agency now trading as Havas Market. It leads with Google Marketing Platform work as one of a few UK Sales Partners; CRO, digital PR, paid search and international SEO are core. The record holds no AI posture, news or jobs. A rival should know the brand is in transition, 13 of its 28 named clients are names only, it runs 0 Google ads of its own, and the Horus read puts it Neutral at -4.3.
doing:
Search Laboratory positions as a data science led international search and performance agency built on analytics and Google Marketing Platform expertise, now folded into Havas Market UK: in plain words, an analytics house selling GMP implementation, training and support plus search and PR for brands entering new markets. The headline claim is one of a few UK Google Marketing Platform Sales Partners. The record lists founded 2005, HQ Leeds with a London office, holdco ownership under Havas (Havas Media Network), c.150 employees as the combined Havas Market UK, and status merged: the homepage says it joined the Havas network in 2021, merged with Havas Market UK in January 2025 and now trades as Havas Market.

The sold mix leads with Data & Measurement (score 3): one of few UK GMP Sales Partners, GA360 attribution and migration case studies. Four lines score 2 as core: CRO (a 44% conversion lift case, MaritzCX landing pages), Content & Digital PR (Soliant, OVO Energy, Citrix ShareFile, Viking and giffgaff cases), Paid Search (Time4Sleep, Withings and Allplants cases) and SEO (TollFreeForwarding organic sales, SaaS non branded click growth). Four lines score 1 without evidence; AI automation, AI search, B2B, email, local and web build score 0. The service menu adds Growth Strategy, Global reach, Digital Marketing Support for Private Equity Businesses and Training and Capacity Building; no proprietary product is listed.

Its AI posture is null: no AI line, no AI claim, 0 on both AI capabilities, the finding for a search agency in 2026. Moves: Havas network in 2021; merged with Havas Market UK in 2025-01 into one 150 strong commerce and performance agency. The record lists no news, case study dates, jobs, ATS or pricing signals; the own site read on 2026-09-29 could read no sitemap URLs although both sitemap files returned 200. Conspicuously absent: any AI search line, paid social depth, owned audience line, or dated work since the merger.
clients:
Client type: mixed; verticals: Retail & ecommerce, SaaS & software, Travel, Telecoms, Energy, Financial services, Pet care, Student accommodation and Charity; the home market is the UK.

The needs read holds 28 clients: 15 observed and 13 names only; the mix leads with PR, reputation and content (N12, 5), organic demand (N1, 3) and paid performance (N2, 3). No case carries a date or excerpt: the deepen pass read no sitemap URLs. TollFreeForwarding came for organic demand (international SEO) and giffgaff for SEO. OVO Energy came for national and international PR coverage, Citrix ShareFile for global PR coverage, Soliant for digital PR and brand awareness, TrustedHousesitters for digital PR and social. Withings came for paid performance (ROAS up 187%, per the slug), Allplants for a 67% paid media revenue uplift, Time4Sleep for a 183% PPC revenue increase. Mars Petcare came for Amazon incremental ad spend analysis, Ann Summers for a Google Analytics 360 attribution model, Sunbelt Staffing for a 52% rise in organic goal completions.

Names only, need inferred from the sold mix: DPG, MaritzCX, Sanctuary Bathrooms, Rentokil, Burton Snowboards, Hootsuite, Viking, Whittard of Chelsea, STAAR Surgical, Tiger Sheds, Visit Britain Shop, Liberty Living and Leeds Hospital Charity; some slugs carry uncoded figures, such as 120% account growth for Hootsuite. Three clients sit on other tracked books: OVO Energy (netpeak, found), Rentokil (builtvisible) and Sunbelt Staffing (neomam-studios).

What the base needs next, tied to KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better) and KJ8 (human provenance as a distribution signal): it is likely, moderate confidence, that this book asks for GA4 and attribution rebuilds and for PR with human provenance, and roughly even, low confidence, whether the ask goes to Havas Market or to a rival, since the brand it bought from no longer trades under its own name.

openings:
The strongest judgment is the transition: the brand a client bought from is merged into Havas Market UK and trades as Havas Market, the record shows no dated work since the 2025-01 merger, so it is likely (moderate confidence) that accounts on the Search Laboratory book, above all the 13 names only rows, answer a rival's call. Falsifier: a Havas Market case study dated after 2025-01 naming one of these clients closes it.

The paid search contradiction is the pitch line: it sells paid search and runs 0 Google ads of its own, a say and do score of 0 of 1. No AI search line (P1 absent), no feed, schema or entity work (P2 absent), no ads tested inside AI assistants (P8 absent): a rival with an audited citation number or a ChatGPT ads holdout result faces no answer. No public pricing model (P5 unknown) leaves an outcome priced offer unanswered. Displacement 53.6 and migration 60.6 on the Monsoon read: a price led, offshore delivered pitch is likely (moderate confidence) to land on the SEO and analytics hours. The shoppers are OVO Energy (netpeak, found), Rentokil (builtvisible) and Sunbelt Staffing (neomam-studios).
watch: I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would test the KJ6 middle the merged agency sits in, with no public pricing of its own.

I6, platform AI labeling enforcement after the EU Article 50(2) deadline, 2 December 2026: new reach penalties for unlabeled AI personas or engagement would strengthen the KJ8 tailwind on its digital PR line.

The 2025-01 merger: whether searchlaboratory.com still resolves as a Search Laboratory homepage at the next compile, or redirects to Havas Market, tells whether the brand and its client book are still contestable under this name.
The 0 Google ads and the single LinkedIn ad: any resumed advertising under the Havas Market name would mean the merged entity, not this record, is the one to track.
